# Dampproofing Insurance — llms.txt
# https://dampproofinginsurance.com

## About
Dampproofing Insurance is a specialty commercial insurance platform serving dampproofing and waterproofing contractors across all 50 states. Operated by Contractors Choice Agency (NPN 8608479), licensed in all 50 states. Founded 2005. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response.

## Core pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the full dampproofing contractor insurance program.
- [Coverage & Services](/services): All eight coverage lines for waterproofing contractors.
- [Coverage Area](/coverage): National dampproofing contractor insurance — all 50 states.
- [Get a Quote](/quote): 15-minute quote request form.
- [About](/about): Contractors Choice Agency and the dampproofing division.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, and contact form.
- [Blog](/blog): Dampproofing contractor insurance guides and insights.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [General Liability for Dampproofing Contractors](/services/general-liability): The foundational coverage — third-party bodily injury, property damage, and completed-operations for foundation callbacks.
- [Contractor Pollution Liability](/services/contractor-pollution-liability): Covers solvent-based membranes, coal tar, and VOC-emitting waterproofing products excluded by standard GL pollution exclusions.
- [Workers' Compensation](/services/workers-compensation): Crawl space entry, chemical exposure, and excavation hazards with proper dampproofing class codes.
- [Commercial Auto & Work Trucks](/services/commercial-auto): Work trucks, equipment trailers, and chemical transport coverage.
- [Tools & Equipment Coverage](/services/tools-equipment): Injection pumps, spray rigs, drainage materials, and hand tools.
- [Commercial Umbrella](/services/umbrella): Excess limits above GL, auto, and employers' liability for catastrophic claims.
- [Inland Marine Coverage](/services/inland-marine): Waterproofing equipment and materials in transit and at multiple job sites.
- [Contractor License & Surety Bonds](/services/bonds): License bonds, performance bonds, and payment bonds for waterproofing contractors.

## Target Contractors
Foundation waterproofing contractors, crawl space encapsulation specialists, interior drainage system installers, exterior dampproofing applicators, French drain installers, sump pump system installers, basement waterproofing companies, crystalline waterproofing applicators, below-grade waterproofing contractors, drainage board installers

## Key Coverage Notes
- Contractor Pollution Liability covers solvent-based membrane chemicals, coal tar pitch, and VOC-emitting waterproofing products excluded by standard GL pollution exclusions
- Workers' comp class codes specific to waterproofing, crawl space, and excavation work
- Completed-operations coverage for long-tail foundation waterproofing callbacks
- Inland marine for spray rigs and injection equipment in transit and at job sites
- Umbrella for commercial projects requiring combined limits above primary GL

## Key Markets
- Texas & Southwest (TX, AZ, NM, OK) — clay soil, high moisture intrusion, expansive soil movement
- Southeast (FL, GA, NC, SC) — high water table, tropical moisture, hurricane flooding demand
- Midwest (IL, OH, MI, IN) — freeze-thaw foundation cracking, basement waterproofing demand
- Northeast (NY, PA, NJ, CT) — old housing stock, dense urban basements, historic preservation
- California (CA, Pacific Coast) — hillside drainage, seismic foundation work, mudslide areas
- Mountain States (CO, UT, WY, ID) — snowmelt, spring drainage, mountain foundation work
- Mid-Atlantic (VA, MD, DC, DE) — government/commercial building waterproofing, tidal areas
- Pacific Northwest (WA, OR) — extreme rainfall, moss/mold, year-round moisture management
